experiment: C5 confirmatory cross-family recursive Canaria composition on SmallViT

conditions.all_frozen_recursive: no Stage-2 update; Stage-3 target = frozen cluster outputs only
conditions.all_unfrozen_recursive: jointly update both local candidates against original span for 600 updates, freeze, Stage-3 target = adapted cluster outputs only
conditions.direct_original_single: matched single directly fit to original span output

P1.statistic: mean paired D = all_unfrozen_recursive validation NMSE - all_frozen_recursive validation NMSE

P2.statistic: geometric mean R = all_unfrozen_recursive validation NMSE / direct_original_single validation NMSE

P3.statistic: all_unfrozen_recursive validation accuracy - direct_original_single validation accuracy

test_safeguard.evaluation: materialize test only after all locked fitting and validation metrics for seed
test_safeguard.statistic: all_unfrozen_recursive test accuracy - direct_original_single test accuracy

overall: CONFIRMATORY_PASS iff eligible_count >= 8 and P1/P2/P3/test_safeguard all pass; otherwise fail/stop without rescue
claim_boundary_if_pass: Cross-family evidence for the recursive joint-adapt/freeze/cluster-only-recompile mechanism on this SmallViT span under this exactly matched grammar; not high-utility Transformer replacement, universal recursion, arbitrary-depth hierarchy, or LLM-scale evidence.
